one_liner: Meta's WhatsApp Business Cloud API is a broad Graph API REST surface; direct developers get a system-user token self-serve without app review, but multi-tenant use needs Meta App Review/Tech Provider status.
auth_notes: Direct developers use long-lived System User access tokens (static bearer). Tech Providers use Business Integration System User tokens obtained via Meta OAuth / Embedded Signup. Multi-user toolkit requires Meta app with advanced access permissions.
access_notes: Direct developers can create a Meta app and use their own data without App Review, with free setup and per-message billing. Serving other businesses' WABAs (multi-user toolkit) requires App Review and Advanced access to whatsapp_business_management and whatsapp_business_messaging.
blocker_notes: Building and testing against own assets is self-serve, but shipping a multi-tenant toolkit requires Meta App Review with Advanced access (and Tech Provider/Embedded Signup for onboarding customers).

evidence.quote: If you are a **direct developer**, meaning only you or your business accesses your own data, use a System User access token.
If you are a **Tech Provider**, use a Business Integration System User access token.
a direct developer using only its own data does “not need to undergo App Review”
